sources: PlayStation official trophy list, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (names, descriptions and grades)

roadmap.title: Story: Chapters 1–2
roadmap.blurb: Play the opening and the first two chapters in order. The mission trophies here unlock as you finish each chapter and its key missions.

roadmap.title: Story: Chapters 3–4 & the Finale
roadmap.blurb: Finish the story. The last two chapters and the final mission close out the gold story trophies; play them in order and the chapter trophies pop as each chapter ends.

roadmap.title: Strangers & Freaks
roadmap.blurb: Work through the stranger mission strands across Leonida. Each strand ends with a final mission and its own trophy — finish all of them before the final story mission, because strangers stop offering work once the story ends.

roadmap.title: Activities, Races & Challenges
roadmap.blurb: The open-world grind: stunts, races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, meditation and the rest. These are all repeatable, so take them at your own pace and use the tracker to watch the counts climb.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & Exploration
roadmap.blurb: Cards, WAiNK spots, garages, vehicle registrations and full map exploration. Collectibles are the long tail — start them early and tick them off as you travel.

roadmap.title: Cleanup, Choices & 100%
roadmap.blurb: The endgame: partner activities, robberies, one-off moments, the 500 choices, and the 100% completion gold. Do the missable ones in this stage before the finale, then mop up the rest in free roam.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and the platinum pops automatically. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, strangers second, activities and collectibles third, cleanup last — and use the tracker to see what is left.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing. It is the first mission of the story and cannot be missed — finish it and the trophy pops at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock when the chapter's final mission ends, so just play the story in order.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies — it pops when the chapter closes.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is the last mission of the game, so it comes after Chapters 1–4 — do the stranger strands first if you want their trophies before the story ends.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the story and finish it. Mission trophies pop at the mission's end.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play and finish The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story missions — complete the setup work and the heist itself.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play and finish the mission Child's Play.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play and finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play and finish the mission VCIA Takedown at the airport.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play and finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion: finish the story, all stranger strands, all activities and all collectibles. The in-game stats screen tracks your percentage — use this guide's tracker and the collectibles filter to find what is left.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, wheelies, drifts and airtime all count. The counter tracks in your stats; stunt jumps around Vice City are the fastest way to rack them up.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: racing, fishing, shooting range, drone races, arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and stunt jumps. One try each is enough — you do not need to win.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge has a score target for gold — take your time, use cover and aim for headshots, and replay any challenge you miss.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location has its own race; you only need one win per location, and you can retry as often as you like.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — street, off-road, boat and air races all count, but each race only counts once. Work through the race list and tick off each win.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing challenge and beat him. Fishing challenges appear at fishing spots — match the catch shown and reel it in before he does.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one arcade game from start to finish. Any arcade cabinet counts — pick the shortest game and play it through.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger strand, then his final mission. Stranger strands are missable after the story ends, so complete Andy's strand before the final story mission.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, then his final mission. Do it before the finale — strangers stop offering work once the story ends.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, then his final mission. Complete it before the final story mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. There are more than 8 strands in the game, so pick any 8 and complete them — but finish them before the finale.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand, then his final mission. Do it before the final story mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand, then his final mission. Do it before the final story mission.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are marked on the map once you find the first one — visit each and complete the meditation.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's stranger strand points you to the animal's territory — track it, take the shot and bring it back.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden across Leonida — each set needs every card in it, so use the collectibles filter and a map to track down the stragglers.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations. WAiNK spots are scattered across the state — the counter tracks your progress, so keep tagging new spots as you travel.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges cover combat, driving, flying and more — the challenge list in the pause menu shows your progress, so pick off the easiest ones first.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. Do it during the story while your partner is available — after the finale, partner activities may not be repeatable.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner without losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route through three nearby shops and keep moving — do it while your partner is available in the story.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — drive or ride a new vehicle and it counts as discovered. The vehicle list in the pause menu shows what you have found; new districts and car meets are the fastest way to fill it.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus with at least 5 enemies nearby and take all 5 down before it ends. Pick a fight with a group — gang hideouts work well — and chain your shots.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in an unscheduled way — take a plane without a ticketed flight. This is a one-off moment at the airport, so do it when the story takes you there and do not leave it for after the finale.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks — destroy or hijack one during a wanted-level rampage or a military encounter. Rhinos appear at high wanted levels and around military sites.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. Go in quiet — no alarms, no witnesses — and get out clean. You can retry if you are spotted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big scores — plan the getaway before you go in, and each successful escape counts toward the five.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Vice City — intercept one, crack it open and lose the heat.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks which areas you have visited — drive through every district, island and backroad until the counter hits 52.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Each gang runs operations in its own territory — hit one per gang and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail at a bar on Ocean Beach and enjoy the view. Any beachfront bar works — sit, order and watch the sunset.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive into a vehicle showroom and smash your way out through the glass. Pick a showroom, build speed and go straight through the front.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play a full game at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley. Any full game counts — finish all frames.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach the partnership moment the trophy describes — it unlocks as the story's partnership reaches its peak. Story-related, so it comes naturally as you play.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game — dialogue and action choices all count, and PlayStation tracks the total. Choices are permanent, so this is the one missable counter to watch: make choices whenever the game offers them, because some cannot be revisited.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail something, then succeed on the second try. It pops when you retry an activity or challenge and pass it the second time around.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness the game's strangest one-off event. It is a single scripted oddity in the world — if you miss it, it may not come back, so explore thoroughly and follow anything unusual you see.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Line up a pedestrian, swing as you pass and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — pass them to your contacts and the total adds up over time.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, food and vehicles all count. The total accumulates across the whole game, so it pops naturally as you gear up.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages go on sale as you progress — check the property site regularly and buy each one when it appears.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Take a vehicle, open the app and register it — any 10 vehicles count.
